survivingClaim: MEASURED (float64, complete row enumeration, S={2,lambda}, Z<=2^21 compact test and Z<=2^18.5 Gaussian test; reproduced by the referee at Z=1024 and four non-grid scales): (a) weight 1 has row mean square equal to the diagonal within about 1 percent (exponent 1.001); (b) Liouville-weighted rows have an off-diagonal excess growing faster than Z (17% of the diagonal at Z=3000, 77% at 2^21; exponent of E_liou/M_liou^2 between 0.13 and 0.20 by test and window, staircase, compatible with 1/6); (c) for every sign weight tried, multiplicative or not (16 weights), the off-diagonal cross moment with the Liouville rows equals (1.0 to 1.16) x (M_w/M_liou) x E_liou: a common row component with amplitude linear in the weight's Mertens-type sum; (d) for thin weights this component is under 2 percent of the mean square in range and the raw exponent of MS_eps/MS_one (0.0005+-0.0003) cannot discriminate. HEURISTIC: if (b),(c) persist to Z~10^30, Bessel gives MS_eps >> Z^(2b-5/6-o(1)), so the row bound (5.36) would fail for eps with b>11/12. Which half of Proposition D (low estimate or high comparison for the probe I_eps) fails remains OPEN; the probe (6.1) was not computed. No statement about zeta zeros.
obstruction: Measurement only; referee does not hold the claim as written. Stops at: (i) the decision 'the low estimate (5.36) fails' rests on a heuristic extrapolation of a common row component (amplitude linear in the weight's Mertens-type sum M_w, energy exponent between 0.13 and 0.20, staircase) from Z <= 2^21 to Z ~ 10^30, where it would first exceed the diagonal for thin weights (under 2 percent of the mean square in range); (ii) the manuscript's probe I_w of (6.1) was not computed, so neither side of Proposition D was measured directly; (iii) the claim that multiplicativity produces the component is refuted: non-multiplicative weights with a large Mertens sum carry the same component.

lesson: A total mean-square exponent cannot detect a term that is 1% of the total and grows like Z^0.07; regress the rows on a reference weight with a large Mertens sum (Liouville) and subtract exact cross-diagonals instead. That isolates the component at hundreds of standard errors. The kappa growth is a staircase, so fitted exponents shift by about 0.03 with the window. Also: in zsh, "$H:rh-push/..." applies the :r modifier and rsync silently copies to a local path; use tar over ssh or brace the variable.
